name: mhgolkar/Arrow
description: Arrow is a free open-source game narrative design tool built on Godot for creating text adventures, interactive stories, and visual novels. Features a visual node editor and HTML export.
score_rationale: Strong 1.3k star narrative design tool with active maintenance through 2025, offering an accessible visual approach to game storytelling.
summary: Godot-based visual narrative design for games and interactive stories
